title: 第三章 小小年纪一把年纪第四章 你还想骗我
slug: 老太太不服老修仙界里做烧烤
content_zh:
“婆婆，你就跟我们回去吧！我们门派很大的！而且许多人都要吃饭，你就跟我们一起走吧！”
叶晚秋就这么被四人带回了凌霄剑派。
“婆婆，这里就是我们凌霄剑派，你先在这里等一下，我们先去把那猪妖的内丹送过去，再带你去院子。”
叶晚秋坐在大树下，梳理夏景景在路上讲给自己的内容。
虽然这地方是叫凌霄剑派，但是不全是剑修，而是会根据入门弟子的天赋学习不同的东西。
就像崔向阳，他虽然是个剑修，但炼丹、阵法都有在学习。
凌霄剑派有一位太上长老，两位掌门，下面十位长老，长老下面就是亲传弟子、内门弟子、外门弟子，以及无数的杂役弟子。
一位长老一个山头，管理手下的弟子。
叶晚秋现在所在的地方是凌云峰，这里是易玄长老，也就是游星她们几人的师父所在的地方。
这位易玄长老还没收亲传弟子，手下有包括游星几人在内的二十几位内门弟子。
叶晚秋能被几人相救，正是因为几人要做任务积攒灵石，换取修炼用的资源，提升实力以求通过亲传弟子的考核……
有灵根天赋的人可以进门派，除去天赋特别突出的人，都要从杂役弟子做起，爬得越高，能得到的资源也越多。
这一关又一关的，堪比现代中考、高考。
叶晚秋叹了口气，看来不管在什么地方，都挺卷的。
很快，一阵脚步声传来，叶晚秋还以为是游星几人回来了，抬头后与一众人大眼瞪小眼。
“这就是游星师姐她们带回来的人？”
“……怎么是个老太太啊？她有灵根吗？”
“你看看她身上的衣服都是破的，该不会是游星师姐心善，在路边将人捡回来做杂役的吧？”
几人你一句我一句，并没有刻意压低声音避开叶晚秋。
叶晚秋被围在正中间，看着围在身边的各类弟子，嘴角的笑都压不住。

谁说只有那男人喜欢好看的，这么多好看又香香的人站在她身边，她都觉得心情好了不少。
“哎，这位奶奶，你测灵根了吗？”有人大着胆子问。
叶晚秋摇摇头，不好意思道：“我，我就是个凡人，是游星和景景她们看我可怜，所以将我带回来的。”
“凡人啊……”那人不再掩饰自己的恶意，直言道：“那你会做什么？总不能什么都不会就来了吧？”
“我会做饭。”叶晚秋笑着说：“我做饭挺好吃的，孩子们，你们要是想吃什么就告诉我，我给……”
“做饭？”
一道声音出现，将她的话打断。
众弟子转头看过去，连忙行礼，“窦师兄好。”
窦胜穿过人群，来到叶晚秋面前，看清她的模样后冷哼一声：“真不知道游星怎么想的，什么人都能带回来。”
叶晚秋看出这人的衣着和游星有些相似，再看这些人的态度，想必他的身份不简单，她装作没听到。
她一个将近六十岁的人了，比这种话更难听的她不是没听过，还不至于跟个小年轻起冲突。
不过很快，游星几人便回来了。
“婆婆，好了，现在跟我们走吧！”夏景景快步跑过来，待看到窦胜后脸色变了变，“窦师兄，你也在啊。”
窦胜冷冰冰的视线在她身上扫了一眼，最终落在游星身上。
content_en:
"Mother-in-law, just come back with us! Our sect is very big! And many people need to eat, so just come with us!"
Ye Wanqiu was brought back to Lingxiao Sword Sect by four people.
"Mother-in-law, this is our Lingxiao Sword Sect. Please wait here for a moment. We will send the pig demon's inner elixir over first, and then we will take you to the yard."
Ye Wanqiu sat under the big tree and sorted out what Xia Jingjing told him on the road.
Although this place is called Lingxiao Sword Sect, it is not all swordsmanship, but will learn different things according to the talents of the entry-level disciples.
Just like Cui Xiangyang, although he is a swordsman, he is also learning alchemy and formation techniques.
The Lingxiao Sword Sect has one supreme elder, two masters, and ten elders below them. Below the elders are direct disciples, inner disciples, outer disciples, and countless handyman disciples.
An elder controls his disciples on a mountaintop.
The place where Ye Wanqiu is now is Lingyun Peak. This is where Elder Yixuan, the master of You Xing and the others, is.
Elder Yixuan also confiscated his direct disciples, and had more than twenty inner disciples including You Xing and others.
Ye Wanqiu was rescued by several people precisely because they had to do tasks to accumulate spiritual stones, exchange them for resources for cultivation, and improve their strength in order to pass the assessment of direct disciples...
People with spiritual root talents can join the sect. Except for those with particularly outstanding talents, they all start as handyman disciples. The higher you climb, the more resources you can get.
This level after level is comparable to the modern high school entrance examination and college entrance examination.
Ye Wanqiu sighed. It seemed that no matter where he was, he was quite curly.
Soon, there was a sound of footsteps. Ye Wanqiu thought it was You Xing and the others who had returned. He raised his head and stared at the others.
"Is this the person that Senior Sister Yuxing and the others brought back?"
"...Why is she an old lady? Does she have spiritual roots?"
"Look at the tattered clothes on her body. Could it be that Senior Sister Youxing is kind-hearted and picks people up on the roadside to work as handymen?"
Everyone said something to each other, without deliberately lowering their voices to avoid Ye Wanqiu.
Ye Wanqiu was surrounded in the middle. Looking at the various disciples surrounding him, he couldn't hold back the smile on his lips.
Who said that only men like good-looking people? With so many good-looking and fragrant people standing beside her, she felt a lot better.
"Hey, grandma, have you tested your spiritual roots?" someone asked boldly.
Ye Wanqiu shook his head and said embarrassedly: "I, I am just a mortal. It was You Xing and Jing Jing who took me back because they felt sorry for me."
"Mortal..." The man no longer concealed his malice and said bluntly: "Then what will you do? You can't just come without knowing anything, right?"
"I can cook." Ye Wanqiu said with a smile: "My cooking is very delicious. Children, if you want to eat something, just tell me and I will give it..."
"Cooking?"
A voice appeared, interrupting her words.
All the disciples turned to look over and saluted quickly, "Hello, Senior Brother Dou."
Dou Sheng walked through the crowd and came to Ye Wanqiu. After seeing her appearance clearly, he snorted: "I don't know what You Xing thinks. He can bring anyone back."
Ye Wanqiu saw that this man's clothes were somewhat similar to those of You Xing. Looking at the attitudes of these people, he must have a different identity, so she pretended not to hear.
She is nearly sixty years old, and she has never heard of words that are uglier than this, and it would not cause a conflict with a young person.
But soon, Yuxing and the others came back.
"Mother-in-law, okay, come with us now!" Xia Jingjing ran over quickly. When she saw Dou Sheng, her expression changed, "Senior Brother Dou, you are here too."
Dou Sheng's cold eyes glanced at her and finally landed on You Xing.
